games.summary: Brisbane Lions are significant favourites at the MCG, backed unanimously by all 31 Squiggle models, and have won three straight including a quality victory over WBD at Gather Round. Wheelo rates Brisbane 18.8pts better overall with superior clearances (+12.6 differential) and contested possession (+11.6). The caveat is Dayne Zorko's new absence (leg/calf) hurting BRI, while Melbourne's Max Gawn (SC 140) continues to dominate hitouts. Melbourne's MCG ODELO lift (+18 net) is real but BRI have won 5 of 6 at this ground in recent seasons. Brisbane should win but Melbourne's fortress advantage and Gawn's ruck dominance could make it a closer contest than the market suggests.
